test_value_counts_basic: test Series.value_counts() to count occurrences of each unique value and return a sorted Series
test_value_counts_null_handling: test Series.value_counts() with dropna=False to include null values in the count results
test_value_counts_bins: test Series.value_counts(bins=N) to bin numeric data into intervals and count occurrences per interval
test_value_counts_datetime: test Index.value_counts() on DatetimeIndex and TimedeltaIndex to count occurrences with proper dtype preservation
test_value_counts_normalize: test Series.value_counts(normalize=True) to return relative proportions instead of raw counts
